comparison_dispositions.CANDIDATE_SEMANTIC_FAILURE: eligible authoritative cell exists but this candidate alone cannot satisfy frozen semantic/result/receipt oracles
comparison_dispositions.SEMANTIC_PASS: all semantic oracles applicable to the cell pass
comparison_dispositions.SHARED_UPSTREAM_BLOCKER: all candidates are blocked by the same unresolved workload input/authority prerequisite; not rankable
comparison_dispositions.TYPED_AUTHORITY_LIMITED: the operation cannot lawfully produce a positive result because required authority/eligibility is missing or negative; same typed state is required from all candidates; not a candidate failure

OR-CERTIFIED-VS-REVIEW.fail: review lane promoted or certified lane erased
OR-CERTIFIED-VS-REVIEW.pass: certified/supported and review/missing-authority lanes remain separate

OR-COMPARABILITY-GUARD.fail: comparison, equivalence, pooling or composition inferred from label/code/interface similarity
OR-COMPARABILITY-GUARD.pass: differences remain DISTINCT_BY_DEFAULT unless every material mismatch is covered by exact operation-scoped positive authority; explicit NONCOMPARABLE preserved

OR-COMPONENT-VECTOR.fail: component loss, reordering identity drift or unauthorized scalar collapse

OR-DENOMINATOR-IDENTITY.fail: QUESTION_N, CATEGORY_COUNT, JOINT_N, EFFECTIVE_N, CONDITIONAL_DENOMINATOR or WEIGHTED_ESTIMAND are substituted
OR-DENOMINATOR-IDENTITY.pass: denominator kind and exact risk-set/design/weight basis are part of result identity

OR-DISCOVERY-COVERAGE.fail: unaccounted, route-specific pruned, reordered-with-identity-drift, or post-outcome denominator changes
OR-DISCOVERY-COVERAGE.pass: every declared frontier candidate has exactly one terminal accounting state; canonical order/frontier hash stable; no post-outcome deletion

OR-EQUAL-VALUE-DISTINCT-SLOTS.pass: equal numeric values in distinct source slots retain distinct coordinate/event identity

OR-EXACT-QUERY-IDENTITY.fail: query broadening, implicit source substitution or denominator drift
OR-EXACT-QUERY-IDENTITY.pass: target + predicate/condition + risk_set + empirical_universe + topology + measure + output_grain are unchanged

OR-FIELD-FORGE-BOUNDARY.fail: carrier physical presence treated as structural truth or Field Forge forced to reconstruct source evidence
OR-FIELD-FORGE-BOUNDARY.pass: ingress exposes empirical facts/releases with ceiling/provenance/uncertainty/negative/component refs but mints no structural admission

OR-JOINT-MORPHOLOGY.fail: flattening, cross-family contamination or cross-respondent substitution
OR-JOINT-MORPHOLOGY.pass: logical joint configuration, executable incidence and observed same-respondent pattern remain distinct and component-addressed

OR-KWAY-CONSERVATION.fail: engine declares parity from marginals/pairs only
OR-KWAY-CONSERVATION.pass: 3-way joint differs between control and XOR fixture despite equal lower-order marginals

OR-LEARNED-RELEASE-IDENTITY.fail: rebuildability used to erase semantic release identity
OR-LEARNED-RELEASE-IDENTITY.pass: discovery-search receipt release has content-addressed identity, source/authority roots, dependency fingerprint, replay receipt and invalidation vector

OR-MINORITY-MULTIMODAL.fail: majority-only pruning or forced unimodal/scalar output
OR-MINORITY-MULTIMODAL.pass: minority and contradictory modes remain separately addressable with exact support

OR-NO-IMPLICIT-POOLING.fail: row union, pooled denominator or merged estimand without positive composition authority
OR-NO-IMPLICIT-POOLING.pass: multi-universe results remain tagged member-wise and denominators/weights/routing stay local

OR-NO-POSTOUTCOME-DENOMINATOR-DELETE.fail: candidate/result removed after outcome to improve yield
OR-NO-POSTOUTCOME-DENOMINATOR-DELETE.pass: declared frontier denominator frozen before outcomes and preserved in receipt

OR-NO-SCALARIZATION.fail: scalar projection without complete unanimous governed basis
OR-NO-SCALARIZATION.pass: incomplete/heterogeneous component vectors remain vectors with typed completeness state

OR-POSITIONED-SUBJECT-BOUNDARY.fail: actor belief/response/disposition/choice/history or normative recommendation is asserted
OR-POSITIONED-SUBJECT-BOUNDARY.pass: interface can address exact downstream fact refs + conditioner-comparability bindings + universe/time/release + learned release + requested target; absent model law returns unresolved/missing authority and no actor prediction

OR-RANKED-MULTISELECT.fail: ordered slots or multiselect occurrences flattened

OR-RAW-VS-SEMANTIC-STATE.fail: physical missing is equated with semantic absence or raw observed code is retyped without authority
OR-RAW-VS-SEMANTIC-STATE.pass: raw physical state and governed semantic response state remain independent dimensions

OR-RECURSIVE-BRANCH.fail: branch flattening, lost child path or parent-conditioned denominator drift
OR-RECURSIVE-BRANCH.pass: each recursive branch path and branch-conditioned support is separately reconstructible

OR-REPEAT-PARITY.fail: warm path changes semantic work, frontier, result or authority state
OR-REPEAT-PARITY.pass: N=1,2,5 executions preserve identical semantic request/result/receipt while only physical metrics may change

OR-REPLAY-IDENTITY.pass: cold or delete/rebuild replay reproduces promised semantic identities and receipts exactly from authoritative roots

OR-ROUTING-UNKNOWN.fail: routing inferred from observed missingness, labels, codes or adjacency

OR-SELECTIVE-INVALIDATION.fail: stale dependent result survives or unrelated global purge/identity churn occurs
OR-SELECTIVE-INVALIDATION.pass: one changed determinant invalidates exactly its dependency closure and preserves unaffected semantic identities

OR-SEMANTIC-PARITY.fail: candidate-specific semantic mismatch, dropped work, widened/narrowed frontier, identity drift, illicit pooling, or invented authority
OR-SEMANTIC-PARITY.pass: candidate semantic outputs, typed states, exact logical identities and replay/coverage receipts match the frozen oracle for the same cell

OR-SOURCE-FIDELITY.fail: loss, reassignment, coercive collapse or replay mismatch
OR-SOURCE-FIDELITY.pass: source snapshot/hash, row/event/coordinate identity, raw values/states, topology and source authority roots are exactly preserved/reconstructible

OR-STRUCTURE-ATTITUDE-BOUNDARY.fail: relation/subjective evidence or compiler default promoted to structural meaning
OR-STRUCTURE-ATTITUDE-BOUNDARY.pass: only exact authorized empirical structural conditioner refs enter discovery; no T03 kind or structural admission inferred

OR-SYNTHETIC-JOINT-CONTAMINATION.pass: incompatible universe/joint-family components without linkage authority fail closed

OR-TYPED-AUTHORITY-LIMIT.fail: candidate fabricates a positive result, collapses missing authority to zero/empty, or is numerically penalized for the authority gap
OR-TYPED-AUTHORITY-LIMIT.pass: all candidates return the same authority-limited state with exact missing/negative authority refs when the cell is not lawfully executable

OR-VALIDATION-STATE.fail: token rename or automatic promotion/rejection beyond authority
OR-VALIDATION-STATE.pass: supported, valid-empty, underpowered/insufficient-support, noncomparable and missing-authority remain distinct with validator refs

OR-XOR-NONLOSS.fail: zero lower-order signal erases the higher-order relation
OR-XOR-NONLOSS.pass: XOR dependency remains discoverable/queryable at 3-way grain

OR-ZERO-NULL-DISTINCTION.pass: OBSERVED_ZERO remains distinct from raw source 0, VALID_EMPTY, UNRESOLVED and UNKNOWN

physical_measurement_gate: Record physical metrics for audit even on typed-authority-limited paths when useful, but never treat them as architecture evidence for semantic work that was not lawfully executable; candidate ranking waits semantic/result/receipt parity on eligible cells.
